title: Gift shop in downtown Las Vegas (city limits, no construction)
assumptions: The company already exists (Neon Keepsakes LLC). Hires staff. Moves into a space that needs no construction. Puts up an exterior sign.

items.name: State Business License (with the LLC formation)
items.note: Retailers "must have a Business License (NRS 372.220)" before the tax permit.
items.condition: Issued with the formation of a Nevada LLC, so an existing Nevada company already holds it (renewed yearly).

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Unemployment insurance employer registration
items.agency: Nevada Department of Employment, Training and Rehabilitation (Employment Security Division)

items.name: City of Las Vegas business license
items.agency: City of Las Vegas, Business Licensing
items.note: A business inside city limits files with the City, not the County.
items.match: city of las vegas business license|lv-license

order.why: Business license before the tax permit.

mustNotInclude.name: Clark County business license
mustNotInclude.why: The store is inside City of Las Vegas limits: "a business located inside Las Vegas city limits files with the City of Las Vegas, not the County."

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
mustNotInclude.why: A store that sells no food needs no food permit.
